keith_notes: Someone, somewhere knows something, and we have no intention of being anybody's fool
In the framework, the why tends to matter far less than the when, with the fundamental narrative usually revealing itself well after the price action has occurred
Price, volume, and volatility serve the ultimate function of incrementally confirming or rejecting enhanced priors
Markets are complex beasts nonpareil - embrace uncertainty and ride the wave of complexity with process as your surfboard
Stop chasing the illusion of complete control - the more control you try to exert, the less you actually have

from_desk.macro_view: The US Dollar remains bullish with higher highs across immediate and intermediate-term signals, pressuring gold and bitcoin lower. Bond yields peaked at last week's Quad 2 cycle highs and have rolled back toward the low-end of the risk range, with the signaling process beginning to shift toward Quad 3 where cyclicals slow and secular growth leads.
